page.overview:
Who is Cary?

is a human barkeep in Kamordah. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Cary is a rather rotund heavy-set figure of a gruff man with strong stubble across his heavy squared jaw. His hair is receding in the back, like a Friar Tuck bald spot where he has a bit of a bowl cut around the sides. He has a series of minor scars and one discolored eye on the right side of his face.

Cary grew up in Kamordah and is the owner of the Gemmed Hearth Inn, a seedy inn with three rudimentary sleeping rooms upstairs. It looks like a mud-spattered warehouse built of simple, bland woods. It has five tables and a beautiful, well-polished curved bar.

The Mighty Nein rented rooms at the Gemmed Heart for the night following Beau's confrontation with her family in .
